Expert in performing Root Cause Analysis and Problem Management 7 or more years in IT/engeneering , including 4 or more years in Platform, Cloud or DevOps roles, with strong expertise in Salesforce and reliability engineering. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related Engineering field; and/or commensurate experience preferred. Verbal and written proficiency in English, Portuguese and/ or Spanish. Title: DATA SCIENTIST PROCUREMENT

Description: Job Description : The Data Scientist develops advanced analytics, machine learning models, and AI-driven solutions that enable predictive insights and intelligent decision-making across procurement. The role transforms procurement data into analytical capabilities that support sourcing strategies, supplier risk monitoring, spend optimization, and procurement performance management. Main Responsibilities: Working closely with data engineering and analytics product teams, this position designs and deploys analytical models and AI-enabled solutions that leverage procurement data to generate scalable insights. The role also contributes to the development of agent-based AI solutions that automate analytical workflows and enhance procurement intelligence. Develop predictive models, simulations, and advanced analytics supporting procurement decision-making, supplier risk monitoring, and sourcing strategies Apply statistical analysis and machine learning techniques to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities within procurement datasets such as spend, supplier performance, and inventory information. Design and develop AI-driven analytical solutions, including intelligent agents and multi-agent workflows that automate procurement intelligence activities such as supplier analysis, risk detection, and decision support. Prototype and deploy advanced analytics and AI use cases that enhance procurement insights and strategic decision-making. Collaborate with data engineers to access, structure, and prepare procurement datasets required for analytical modeling and AI applications. Partner with procurement analytics product teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities into dashboards, decision-support tools, and analytical applications. Monitor and continuously improve analytical models and AI solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, and business relevance. Position Challenges: Translating complex procurement data into analytical models that generate actionable business insights. Developing predictive and AI-driven solutions that remain interpretable and useful for procurement stakeholders. Collaborating effectively across technical teams (data engineering, analytics) and procurement business teams. Identifying high-value opportunities where advanced analytics and AI can improve procurement decision-making. Managing evolving analytical requirements in a rapidly changing digital and AI landscape. Position Requirements: Languages English: Advanced. Academic Background Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or related analytical fields. Experience applying analytics or AI solutions to operational or business decision processes. Experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics techniques to real-world business problems. Advanced SQL skills for data manipulation and analysis of large transactional datasets. Experience developing AI-enabled analytical solutions, including the use of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents or multi-agent workflows to automate analytical tasks or decision-support processes. Familiarity with modern data platforms and analytics environments (e.g., cloud data warehouses, data lakes, or similar analytical infrastructures). Soft Skills Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capabilities. Ability to translate complex analytical outputs into clear insights for business stakeholders. Effective collaboration with both technical teams (data engineering, analytics) and procurement stakeholders Curiosity and experimentation mindset with interest in emerging analytics and AI technologies. Title: Senior PIM Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls is seeking a highly skilled Senior PIM Engineer to support both Build and Run teams for our enterprise product data platform. The role spans solution design, data modeling, integrations, bulk data onboarding, and production support. We value platform versatility (e.g., Akeneo, Pimcore, Stibo, Salsify) and have a strong preference for Inriver experience; however, Inriver is not mandatory. You will partner with product owners, architects, and business stakeholders to implement and enhance PIM capabilities—product data modeling, attribute/taxonomy management, validation rules, enrichment workflows, localization, versioning, and system integration ensuring high data quality and reliable operations across downstream systems (eCommerce, ERP, CRM, CMS, DAM, and digital channels). What will you do? Build (PIM Engineering) Design and evolve PIM data models (entities, relationships, attributes, CVLs), taxonomy/classification, validation rules, localization, and versioning. Develop/enhance workflows and enrichment processes; implement bulk data loads (imports/ETL), transformations, and data validation/cleansing. Build and maintain RESTful integrations with ERP, eCommerce, CRM, CMS, DAM, search, and analytics platforms (incl. event or message‑based patterns). Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and performance/security best practices; produce technical documentation (designs, integration specs, data models, runbooks) Run (Production Support & Operations) Provide L2/L3 support, triage incidents, resolve defects/performance issues, and handle user requests per SLAs. Perform root‑cause analysis (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective/preventive actions. Monitor platform health, integration jobs, workflow queues, and data synchronization, tune jobs for throughput and stability. Partner with business teams to unblock enrichment, data readiness, and channel syndication; support release/deployment and platform upgrades. Platform & Engineering Excellence Apply OOP/SOLID principles and design patterns to deliver scalable, maintainable solutions. Implement unit tests, participate in CI/CD pipelines, and practice continuous improvement in an Agile/Scrum environment. Champion data quality and governance, including completeness, consistency, stewardship processes, and auditability across channels. What are we looking for? Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/IT or equivalent experience. 6–8 years of hands‑on engineering experience with C#/.NET, RESTful APIs, and MS SQL Server. Practical experience with Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, Azure SQL) and CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines or equivalent). Strong grasp of object‑oriented design, SOLID, testing, debugging, performance tuning, and secure coding. Proven experience delivering and supporting enterprise integrations and data flows in a fast‑paced, Agile environment. Excellent problem‑solving and communication skills; able to operate independently and collaborate with technical and non‑technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Inriver PIM (strongly preferred but not required): data model configuration (entities/links/CVLs), workflows, extensions/connectors, bulk imports, and operational monitoring. Experience with other PIM platforms (Akeneo, Pimcore, Stibo, Salsify) and PIM APIs. Experience integrating PIM with ERP (e.g., SAP), eCommerce, CMS, DAM, and downstream digital channels. Knowledge of event‑based integrations and data synchronization patterns (webhooks, queues, pub/sub). Exposure to data governance, stewardship processes, and omnichannel distribution. What do we offer? Comprehensive benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Supportive and inclusive work environment. Commitment to work-life balance and employee well-being. Engagement in meaningful projects that make a difference.
